g.text: Title: 08 / Core and BRAM decoupling - review placement next

g.text: These capacitors sit between VCCINT_1V0 and ground. They support rapid FPGA current changes.

g.text: Confirm effective capacitance, regulator stability and voltage at the FPGA under load.

g.text: REVIEW: re-place the inherited capacitor groups for the new CSG325 power balls.

g.text: Capacitance value alone is insufficient: placement and rail impedance matter.

g.text: All groups share the same rail; page spacing does not create separate supplies.

g.text: 08 / Core decoupling - local charge for the 1.0 V rail

g.text: C20/C21 / BULK: larger charge reservoirs support the distributed rail.

g.text: C22-C27 / 4.7 uF: local bypass distributed near the FPGA power pins.

g.text: C28-C37 / 470 nF: small bypass capacitors support fast current changes.
